prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web app screenshot comp for a real civic incident coordination platform called ResQCloud. Layout: compact persistent deep teal left rail, white top bar, warm off-white canvas, clear operations heading, calm situation summary, compact incident counts, readable incident queue, and next-actions panel. Preserve the current ResQCloud warm ivory and deep teal identity with restrained brick accent, accessible semantic severity colors, humanist sans, fine dividers, compact controls, simple line icons. Show realistic fictional incidents and mark them Sample incidents. No invented emergency-service outcomes or external calls. No gradients, glass, neon or militarized motifs. Corrected first row: Vehicle collision near River Road; Critical; Under review; Injury status not confirmed. The comp was generated from an earlier draft and then edited with these corrections.
